13 Rajab Hai Kabay Pe Mukhtar Hussain Fatehpuri.

ALLAH Ke Makaan Mein Qadam Murtaza Ke Dekh.
Jab Chehra-e-Khuda Hai Ali Keh Chukay Nabi.
Hub-e-Yaqeen Chehray Se Chehra Mila Ke Dekh.
